items.front: Who created the HDI and in which year's report?
items.back: Mahbub-ul-Haq with Amartya Sen; first UNDP HDR in 1990.
Health (life expectancy), knowledge (schooling), living standard (GNI per capita PPP).

items.front: How is HDI aggregated since HDR 2010?
items.back: Geometric mean of the three equally weighted sub-indices.

items.front: Global MPI — agencies, method and formula?
items.back: UNDP + OPHI; Alkire-Foster method; MPI = H × A (headcount × intensity).

items.front: How does India's National MPI differ from Global MPI?
items.back: 3 dimensions but 12 indicators (adds maternal health & bank accounts); by NITI Aayog.

items.front: Which report defined sustainable development, and when?
items.back: Brundtland Report 'Our Common Future', 1987 — intergenerational equity.

items.front: SDGs — number of goals/targets and adoption year?
items.back: 17 goals, 169 targets; adopted Sep 2015 (2030 Agenda); succeeded 8 MDGs.

items.front: SDG India Index — publisher and score bands?
items.back: NITI Aayog; Aspirant 0-49, Performer 50-64, Front Runner 65-99, Achiever 100.
items.examPoint: SDG India Index — NITI Aayog, bands

items.front: AP's standout SDG India Index performance?
items.back: Front Runner; topped Goal-7 (Affordable & Clean Energy) among States.
